description: messy: mostly-English CV describing a foreign nurse mid-recognition (Defizitbescheid received, Anpassungslehrgang in progress) working an interim helper job -- genuinely ambiguous whether 'roles' should be the target qualification (pflegefachkraft) or the current interim job (pflegehelfer); both extractors picked a defensible answer here, so this case checks the unambiguous fields only (recognition status, experience, city)
cv_text:
CV
Currently in the German nursing recognition process (Anerkennungsverfahren) for Pflegefachkraft.
Received the Defizitbescheid last month, now doing the Anpassungslehrgang at a hospital in Regensburg.
Working temporarily as a care assistant (Pflegehelfer) in a nursing home while completing it.
3 years of nursing experience back home before moving to Germany.
Deutsch B1, English native
